name: suspender handstand push up
description: An advanced inverted press with the feet supported by straps and the hands on the floor, challenging the shoulders, triceps and core.
instructions: Set the straps securely, place your feet in the foot cradles and plant your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands toward the anchor until you reach a stable inverted or high pike position.
Brace your core and bend your elbows to lower your head under control.
Press back up to straight arms, using a wall or spotter if needed.
